description: This file defines the BaseFormatter2 class, a core component for formatting in the behave testing framework. It manages the lifecycle of test elements such as files, features, scenarios, rules, and steps, and provides methods to handle their start and end events.

classes.name: BaseFormatter2
classes.description: A base formatter class implementing core formatting functionalities and managing test execution lifecycle events.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the BaseFormatter2 with stream opener, config, and optional formatter.

methods.name: uri
methods.description: Handles the start of a new file URI, ensuring test run is started and previous file is finished.

methods.name: feature
methods.description: Handles the start of a feature, ensuring previous feature is finished.

methods.name: background
methods.description: Placeholder method for background, currently ignored.

methods.name: rule
methods.description: Handles the start of a rule, finishing previous rule or scenario.

methods.name: scenario
methods.description: Handles the start of a scenario.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Handles the start of a test step.

methods.name: result
methods.description: Handles the end of a test step.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Handles end of file, finishing current file.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Finishes the test run and closes the stream.

methods.name: _ensure_testrun_started
methods.description: Ensures the test run has started, triggers start if not.

methods.name: _ensure_file_started
methods.description: Ensures a file has started, triggers start if not.

methods.name: _finish_current_step
methods.description: Ends the current step if active.

methods.name: _finish_current_scenario
methods.description: Ends the current scenario if active.

methods.name: _finish_current_rule_or_scenario
methods.description: Ends the current rule or scenario.

methods.name: _finish_current_rule
methods.description: Ends the current rule.

methods.name: _finish_current_feature
methods.description: Ends the current feature.

methods.name: _finish_current_file
methods.description: Ends the current file.

methods.name: _finish_current_testrun
methods.description: Ends the current test run.

methods.name: _finish_any_elements
methods.description: Finishes all active test elements.
